ui_state.question: A stock breaks above a significant 6-month resistance at ₹500 with high volume. During the subsequent pullback to ₹500, what technical role does the ₹500 level now play, and why?
ui_state.answer: It becomes new SUPPORT (Role Reversal). Trapped shorts rush to buy back at breakeven (₹500), while sidelined traders who missed the original breakout eagerly buy the first retest, creating a massive wave of fresh demand.

beats.en_narration: Exactly! 500 now acts as support because trapped shorts buy to cover and waiting buyers step in.
